'''Republic High Command''' was the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] agency that oversaw the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic's war effort]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It held authority over the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], the [[Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|Republic Starfighter Corps]], and the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], and possibly the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], [[Jedi command/Legends|Jedi Command]], [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]], and [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]]. It was presumably a part of the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]]. The [[War Council Advisory Panel/Legends|War Council Advisory Panel]] and [[Homeworld Security Command]] might have also been subdivisions of it.

During the Clone Wars, none of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] military advisers knew of his double identity as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and instigator of the war. The High Command ordered the start of the [[Victor Initiative Project]].

After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], Republic High Command presumably became [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]].
